label: Catholic Church, Codex Iuris Canonici… attacks Fideist reply to the definition bridge…
note: Against the reply: the practice's own law treats teaching a conciliarly condemned doctrine as an offence against the faith, so the practice itself does not treat conciliar condemnations as optional theory about it. Not a refutation: the fideist can hold that law, too, is outside grammar; that is the open question of who fixes a practice's grammar.
